outcome: Timing of eclampsia (during delivery hospitalization vs. postpartum readmission)
cohort: Women with an admission for delivery of a neonate > 20 weeks gestation
finding: Almost half of the eclampsia cases occurred after discharge from the delivery admission, with 95% of these occurring within the first 2 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Women readmitted for eclampsia were more likely to have a cesarean delivery compared to those not readmitted for eclampsia.
